sections.heading: Our Vision and History
body: Founded in 2004, Apex GeoConsulting emerged from a desire to combine high-level earth sciences with robust civil and environmental engineering practices.

Over two decades, we have evolved into a full-scale consultancy, servicing public administrations and private industrial giants alike. We believe that safe foundations and thorough environmental modeling are the absolute pillars of sustainable development.

sections.heading: Our Social Stewardship
body: As engineering professionals, our responsibility extends beyond paid client projects. We actively invest our time and specialized technical tools to educate citizens and the younger generation on hydraulic safety, climate change impacts, and subsoil conservation.
Through collaborations with regional schools and city councils, we provide hands-on workshops and public risk management seminars completely free of charge.

seo.title: Privacy and Cookie Policy | Apex GeoConsulting
seo.description: Read how we collect, store, and process your personal details in compliance with European GDPR laws and contact regulations.

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
body: The Data Controller is Apex GeoConsulting & Engineering S.r.l., with registered office in Corso Vittorio Emanuele II, 45 - 10125 Turin (TO), Italy. Email: contact@apexgeoconsulting.com.

We treat the privacy of our visitors, partners, and clients with supreme seriousness. Any personal data collected will be processed transparently, lawfully, and in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (EU) 2016/679.

sections.heading: 2. Collected Personal Data
body: We collect personal information that you provide directly through our Contact Form, including your Name, Email address, and the content of your message. Your consent is explicitly obtained prior to form dispatch.
Additionally, the website may collect technical diagnostic details (cookies, IP addresses) strictly necessary to serve the web application and optimize responsiveness.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes of Processing
body: To respond to requests for technical consultancy or project estimates.
To ensure proper operational maintenance and cybersecurity of our server platforms.
We will never sell, lease, or distribute your email addresses to third-party marketing companies.

sections.heading: 4. Your Rights
body: Under the GDPR regulation, you have the absolute right to request access to your personal data, request the correction or deletion of your records, restrict or object to certain processing, and exercise data portability.
To request records deletion, please transmit a written request to contact@apexgeoconsulting.com.
